items.question: At the meeting tomorrow, Jing Huang, vice 116. Gabary Ltd. decided to expand its president of sales, will discuss the company's ------- to achieve its sales goals.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：题干为“At the meeting tomorrow, Jing Huang, vice 116. Gabary Ltd. decided to expand its president of sales, will discuss the company's --..-. to achieve its sales goals.”，空格处完成后应为“efforts”。选择理由：该选项同时满足句子所需的词性、语法结构、固定搭配和语义；其余选项至少一项不符。正确答案：B（efforts）。
